transcript: Yeh hai America ki sabse mehengi building. Main hoon New York mein and this right here is Central Park Tower. Yeh 131st floor tak jaati hai and this is honestly insane. Iske top ke jo teen floor hain na, woh apartment is on sale for 2500 crore rupaye and no one has bought it. But who has bought the most expensive apartment? Right here jo dusri building hai, Central Park South, iske top ke char floor wala apartment is bought for 2300 crore rupees. But yeh khareeda kisne? Ken Griffin. Kya karte hain Ken Griffin? He runs a hedge fund called Citadel. Logon ke paise manage karte hain. Sabse bada insight jo maine liya hai bhai ki aap apni job mein har mahine salary kamate reh jaaoge, but the real people who are unlocking true wealth are either starting their own business, raising money for it, or they're managing other people's wealth. And that is why they're able to afford such buildings.
caption:
New York always makes me feel poor!

The last morning i had in new york, i took a walk in central park to see the tallest skyscrapers of the city in the billionaire’s row. These buildings have 3-4 floor duplexes worth 2300-2500 Crore Rupees!

I immediately asked perplexity who owns these apartments
